query: Explain how `run_simple` in `src/werkzeug/serving.py` starts the development server: how it validates its arguments, how it wraps the application for static files and for the debugger (including which hosts the debugger trusts), how it picks the kind of server to build through `make_server`, and how it behaves differently when the reloader is enabled or when it is itself running inside the reloader (including how the listening socket is handed over).

operations.name: The port must be an integer
expressions: raise TypeError("port must be an integer")

operations.name: Static file mappings wrap the application in shared-data middleware
operations.needed_for: how it wraps the application for static files

operations.name: The debugger wraps the application and the chosen hostname is added to its trusted hosts
operations.needed_for: how it wraps the application for the debugger

operations.name: A threaded and a multi-process server cannot be combined
expressions: raise ValueError("Cannot have a multi-thread and multi-process server.")
operations.needed_for: how it picks the kind of server (invalid combination)

operations.name: The server class is threaded, forking or plain depending on the arguments
operations.needed_for: how it picks the kind of server

dependencies.name: The hostname is added to the debugger's trusted hosts unless it is a wildcard address
A process running inside the reloader reuses the listening socket handed down through an environment variable; the parent makes the socket inheritable and publishes it
dependencies.needed_for: how the listening socket is handed over

dependencies.name: Whether the process is a reloader child is decided from an environment variable
dependencies.needed_for: when it is itself running inside the reloader

dependencies.name: With the reloader on the server runs under it and is always closed; otherwise it simply serves forever
dependencies.needed_for: how it behaves when the reloader is enabled

revisions.change: Removed the startup-banner dependency. Its governing condition (`if not is_running_from_reloader():`) occurs twice in the function, so it cannot be evidenced by a single-occurrence expression, and the question did not ask about the banner. Added two dependencies the question does ask about: which hosts the debugger trusts (the wildcard condition) and making the socket inheritable. The question now says so explicitly.
